name: MCP capability drift guard
summary: Block toolkit MCP tool calls when the server, tool name, or observed description is not pinned.
description: A deterministic fail-closed pre-tool gate that accepts only curated Youdede MCP server and tool identities from a generated pin registry and rejects unknown or description-drifted capabilities.
refuses: It does not trust MCP annotations, server names, or tool descriptions that are absent from the generated pin registry.
It does not silently accept added, removed, renamed, or description-drifted tools from curated servers.
It does not widen egress, secret, filesystem, subprocess, or mutation authority for an MCP server.

entrypoints.purpose: Compare a toolkit MCP tool call and any observed inventory with the generated capability pin registry.
